trustedProxies.description: Express trusted proxy setting for X-Forwarded-* headers. Defaults to ["loopback"]. Use true only when the final trusted proxy overwrites client-supplied forwarded headers.

enabled.description: Compatibility shim. false suppresses optional service proxy listen/public layers only; localhost proxying remains enabled.

listen.description: Optional service-only listener address. Presence enables the standalone service proxy listener.

publicBaseUrl.description: Optional public base URL for service host aliases.
